verses.text: <pb/><t>Ka ji addu'ata, ya Allah,</t> <t>Kada ka ƙi jin roƙona!</t>
<t>Ka saurare ni, ka amsa mini,</t> <t>Gama damuwata ta gajiyar da ni tiƙis.</t>
<t>Hankalina ya tashi saboda yawan kurarin maƙiyana,</t> <t>Saboda danniyar mugaye.</t> <t>Sukan jawo mini wahala,</t> <t>Suna jin haushina suna ƙina. <pb/></t>
<t>Azaba ta cika zuciyata,</t> <t>Tsorace-tsoracen mutuwa sun yi mini nauyi.</t>
<t>Tsoro da rawar jiki sun kama ni,</t> <t>Na cika da razana.</t>
<t>Na ce, “Da a ce ina da fikafikai kamar kurciya,</t> <t>Da sai in tashi, in tafi, in nemi wurin hutawa!</t>
<t>In tafi can nesa,</t> <t>In yi wurin zamana a hamada.</t>
<t>Zan hanzarta in nemi mafaka</t> <t>Daga iska mai ƙarfi da hadiri.” <pb/></t>
<t>Ka hallaka su, ya Ubangiji, ka birkitar da maganarsu,</t> <t>Gama na ga hargitsi da tawaye a birni.</t>
<t>Dare da rana suna ta yawo a kan garu suna ta kewaye birnin,</t> <t>Birnin kuwa cike yake da laifi da wahala.</t>
<t>Akwai hallaka a ko'ina,</t> <t>Tituna suna cike da azzalumai da 'yan danfara. <pb/></t>
<t>Da a ce maƙiyina ne yake mini ba'a,</t> <t>Da sai in jure.</t> <t>Da a ce abokin gābana ne yake shugabancina,</t> <t>Da sai in ɓuya masa.</t>
<t>Amma kai ne, aminina,</t> <t>Abokin aikina ne, abokina ne kuma!</t>
<t>Dā mukan yi taɗi da juna ƙwarai,</t> <t>Mukan tafi Haikali tare da sauran jama'a.</t>
<t>Allah ya sa mutuwa ta auko wa maƙiyana ba labari,</t> <t>Allah ya sa su gangara ƙasar matattu da ransu!</t> <t>Mugunta tana cikin gidajensu da zukatansu. <pb/></t>
<t>Amma ina kira ga Allah, yă taimake ni,</t> <t>Ubangiji kuwa zai cece ni.</t>
<t>Koke-kokena da nishe-nishena</t> <t>Suna hawa zuwa gare shi da safe, da tsakar rana, da dad dare,</t> <t>Zai kuwa ji muryata.</t>
<t>Zai fisshe ni lafiya</t> <t>Daga yaƙe-yaken da nakan yi da magabtana masu yawa.</t>
<t>Allah, shi wanda yake mulki tun fil azal,</t> <t>Zai ji ni, zai kore su.</t> <t>Ba abin da suka iya yi a kai,</t> <t>Domin ba su tsoron Allah. <pb/></t>
<t>Abokina na dā,</t> <t>Ya yi wa abokansa faɗa,</t> <t>Ya ta da alkawarinsa.</t>
<t>Kalmominsa sun fi mai taushi,</t> <t>Amma ƙiyayya tana a zuciyarsa,</t> <t>Kalmominsa sun fi mai sulɓi,</t> <t>Amma suna yanka kamar kakkaifan takobi. <pb/></t>
<t>Ka gabatar da wahalarka ga Ubangiji,</t> <t>Zai kuwa taimake ka,</t> <t>Ba zai bari a ci nasara a kan mutumin kirki ba, faufau. <pb/></t>
<t>Amma kai, ya Allah, za ka jefar da masu kisankai, da maƙaryata can ƙasa cikin zurfafa,</t> <t>Kafin su kai rabin kwanakinsu a duniya.</t> <t>Amma ni, zan dogara gare ka.</t>
